section_role: Data Processing Pipeline and Related Work

method_evidence.claim: Full-level data processing pipeline consists of three core steps: data rendering and format conversion, asset filtering, and post processing.
method_evidence.anchor: For full-level data, our processing pipeline consists primarily of three core steps: data rendering and format conversion, asset filtering, and post processing.

method_evidence.claim: Data rendering and conversion standardizes assets to single-frame static mesh representations with aligned orientations.
method_evidence.anchor: We combine manual annotation and automated conversion workflows to uniformly convert all 3D assets into single-frame static mesh representations with aligned orientations.

method_evidence.claim: Multi-view rendering uses Blender with orthographic and perspective projection camera modes.
method_evidence.anchor: The rendering configuration includes two camera modes—orthographic projection and perspective projection—to cover different visual representation requirements.

method_evidence.claim: Asset filtering excludes data with poor geometric quality, poor texture quality, and large areas of thin structures.
method_evidence.anchor: We comprehensively utilize the visual quality of rendering results and the geometric attributes of original 3D assets for data filtering, primarily excluding the following three categories of inadequate data: (1) Data with poor geometric quality... (2) Data with poor texture quality... (3) Data with large areas of thin structures.
